verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's Tech and Digital Solutions page says the firm developed its own Generative AI legal assistant with Legora to streamline legal workflows, so it does document an AI assistant of its own. The evidence is a single thin mention: it does not show clients can access it inside a product or delegate tasks to it. The questionnaire-based generators (SCC and Term Sheet) are document automation, not an AI assistant, and Luminance is a third-party review tool, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant is client-facing and built into a product, a description of which tasks can be delegated and how, any agentic or multi-step execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: A collaboration with Legora to develop our Generative AI legal assistant to streamline and enhance legal workflows.
